sourceConfigDifferences: Original installed Vitest4.1.11 / Node24.19.0 with minimal node config, not the full original config. No aliases, DOM/canvas/host-port setup, feature-wall define, GC/WebStorage flags or extended timeouts. All three suites use original synthetic send/response callbacks; keepalive tests restore original fake timers. No original assertions or imports replaced.

Transport package trees are pinned. Optional ws native peers are disabled per child via WS_NO_BUFFER_UTIL=1 and WS_NO_UTF_8_VALIDATE=1; real ws/tweetnacl/zod implementations remain. Native-addon/performance, full config and real SSH equivalence are not established.
runs.limits: Five original in-memory cases cover established unsubscribe, close deferred during replay until the new server id, never-sent local close, deferred replay error and close after prior replay error. Spies simulate sends/responses; no actual server subscription leak is measured. No rewritten-product or SSH parity.
